items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: I think he was even greater than Baby Dotson. Baby Bots was a good drummer, was a fine drummer, as in his prime he was still a good drummer.

ctx.x: Well Lee Collins always said that.

Yeah, that ever hitting New Orleans as far as execution. I read Happy would have a lot of things to back him, over him, and everywhere, you know. And he'd make a break and hit all those different things, and coming on time he was a great drummer. I think he was even greater than Baby Dotson. Baby Bots was a good drummer, was a fine drummer, as in his prime he was still a good drummer. But Happy was supposed to have been the best. And the old man, and his first band in 1911, Cottrell. Oh yeah, the old man. Yeah,…
